I am writing to apply for the Campaign Manager position at Rubio Monocoat. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to bring structure and performance focus to your campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, all while tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Mariam Berrezzouk,

I am writing to express my interest in the Campaign Manager position at Rubio Monocoat. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to bring structure, clarity, and performance focus to your digital campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I track performance with Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Search Console, using data to guide decisions. This experience has taught me how to translate business objectives into actionable briefs and KPIs, and how to align stakeholders from the start.

While my experience is primarily in SEO and content, I have a solid understanding of digital marketing and performance. I am eager to apply my analytical mindset to campaign optimization and lead nurturing. I am particularly drawn to Rubio Monocoat's innovative culture and international reach. The opportunity to work with a team of 20 marketing professionals and contribute to campaigns that impact over 80 countries is inspiring.

I am structured, adaptable, and quick to learn new tools. I am comfortable with English and Turkish, and I am improving my Dutch. I am passionate about wood and craftsmanship, which aligns with Rubio Monocoat's mission.

I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a strong candidate. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Campaign Management: planning, coordination, optimization, KPI setting, stakeholder alignment
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
